_doc: Recipe per transformers model_type: LoRA target modules and the precision of the paper recipe. `fp16_amp` = fp32 weights with fp16 autocast (torch_dtype float32); `bf16` = bf16 weights with bf16 autocast. `attn_implementation` is the attention of the training forward under mixed precision (flash kernels need fp16 / bf16); selection uses `selection_attn_implementation` and `selection_prefix_dtype`. The Phi-2 fp16 selection prefix is a measured optimization, not the upstream precision recipe. Model types that are not listed use `default`.
